issue.input_source: AI-based multi-model ensemble combining several AI and physics-based S2S forecast systems
issue.scientific_status: Ensemble-mean fields only. This issue has no probability, spread or extreme products.

initial_condition_source.label: AI S2S multi-model ensemble mean
initial_condition_source.description: AI-based multi-model ensemble combining several AI and physics-based S2S forecast systems

climatology_alignment.operation_order: for each forecast system, subtract the 2011–2025 mean for each exact valid calendar day and aggregate seven days of the ensemble mean; then average the systems
climatology_alignment.message: Anomalies are relative to the 2011–2025 average for the same calendar days.

issue.anomaly_baseline_note: Anomaly taken against climatology data for the respective variables

observation_verification.message: Verification is withheld until every required observation day in a valid week is available.

grid.value_order: latitude-major row order; latitude is north-to-south

rainfall_anomaly.label: Rainfall anomaly
rainfall_anomaly.description: Weekly-mean forecast minus a seasonally matched calendar-day climatology
rainfall_anomaly.baseline: 2011–2025 average for the same calendar days

temperature_anomaly.label: Temperature anomaly
temperature_anomaly.description: Weekly-mean forecast minus a seasonally matched calendar-day climatology
temperature_anomaly.baseline: 2011–2025 average for the same calendar days

wind850_mean.label: Weekly mean 850 hPa wind
wind850_mean.description: Shading is the speed of the weekly ensemble-mean wind vector; arrows are the weekly ensemble-mean U/V components

wind850_anomaly.label: 850 hPa wind anomaly
wind850_anomaly.description: Shading is the weekly ensemble-mean vector speed minus the climatological mean of yearly vector speeds; arrows are the U/V anomaly from the climatological mean
wind850_anomaly.baseline: 2011–2025 average for the same calendar days
